text: {"score":3,"justification":"Numbers match the card and tool outputs, and the 'inconclusive' leaning is cautious and fits the hybrid_review result. But the rationale is internally muddled and the evidence is thin, so an investigator would have to redo some work. The cited claims are weak support for the points made.","problems":["Rationale says 'may mean notes inflated to match the bill', which contradicts the headline that no charts were below billed level and the 'charts support the codes' line; this is speculative and not backed by the packet.","Calls 16.7% of notes 'data work the claims don't show' while the card says 5 of 21 notes claiming moderate-plus data; the 16.7% denominator (30 charts) differs from the 5/21 figure, which is confusing.","Redundant sentence 'The 19.3% 99215 on a low-complexity panel (expected 1.8%)' repeats the opening.","Cited examples (C0013199, C0013202) are only two low-complexity claims and were not documented-chart claims; they do not support the documentation findings. Better examples would be the documented 99215 claims (e.g. C0013333 and C0013382, which are low-complexity yet documented as high MDM, 45 and 42 minutes).","Omits that two of the documented-supported 99215 claims were on 0-condition patients, which is the key tension between complexity and documentation.","Next steps are generic: 'request a larger sample' without specifying claims, and 'Re-screen' is vague; no step on the 5 notes with data review but no lab or test on claim.","Says 'too thin to judge' although 30 of 30 charts were usable and returned, with 5 documented 99215 claims."]}
